$comment: Generated by build.py --schema from build.py and baseline.json 1.0.0. Do not edit; build.py remains the check.
title: agentic-guardrails layer (org.json, local.<host>.json)

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for the editor.

note.description: Free text for people; build.py ignores it.

layer_format.description: Shape of this file; 1 when missing. ./build.py --migrate updates it.

requires_baseline.description: Baseline versions this layer was written for, e.g. >=1.0 <2.

set.description: Values without a security direction. Only what differs from the baseline belongs here.

install.launchagent_label.description:
Name of the LaunchAgent that runs the ssh-agent with a fixed socket. To change it later, run uninstall.sh first.
Baseline: ""

logging.enabled.description:
Whether the hook writes its decision log.
Baseline: true

logging.keep_files.description:
How many rotated log files are kept.
Baseline: 3

logging.max_bytes.description:
Size in bytes at which the log file is rotated.
Baseline: 5242880

logging.max_command_chars.description:
Commands in the log are cut to this many characters.
Baseline: 300

logging.path.description:
File of the hook's decision log (read with scripts/guard-log.py).
Baseline: "~/Library/Logs/claude-guard/decisions.jsonl"

organization.description.description:
One line about the organisation, for the auto-mode text.
Baseline: ""

organization.name.description:
Name of the organisation in the auto-mode text the classifier reads.
Baseline: ""

organization.person.description:
The person who works on this machine; the auto-mode text names them as the one who administers the servers.
Baseline: ""

organization.primary_use.description:
What Claude Code is mainly used for here, for the auto-mode text.
Baseline: ""

organization.remote_targets.description:
What the ssh servers are (e.g. web servers, customer portal); the auto-mode text treats them all as production.
Baseline: ""

organization.source_control.description:
Where the code lives (e.g. a GitHub organisation), one per line, for the auto-mode text.
Baseline: []

package_protection.sfw_works_in_sandbox.description:
Whether Socket Firewall works inside the sandbox. While false, a package install is handed to your terminal right away.
Baseline: false

patch_scan.root.description:
Folder the projects in patch scan projects are relative to; /patch-check and the --audit search start here.
Baseline: "~/Documents"

ssh.search_domain.description:
Domain that short host names in ssh hosts belong to: web01 means web01.<search domain>.
Baseline: ""

add.description: Facts added to the baseline's lists.

domains.code_hosts.description:
Code hosts the sandbox may reach (git over https, archives, raw files).
Baseline: ["github.com", "api.github.com", "codeload.github.com", "objects.githubusercontent.com", "raw.githubusercontent.com", "gitlab.com"]

domains.documentation.description:
Documentation sites WebFetch may read without a question. Not added to the sandbox network.
Baseline: ["code.claude.com", "docs.claude.com", "docs.anthropic.com", "platform.claude.com", "developer.mozilla.org", "docs.npmjs.com", "www.npmjs.com", "www.php.net", "php.net", "laravel.com", "vuejs.org", "angular.dev", "nextjs.org", "docs.astro.build", "ionicframework.com", "capacitorjs.com", "docs.python.org", "go.dev", "pkg.go.dev", "docs.docker.com", "developer.hashicorp.com", "registry.terraform.io", "learn.microsoft.com", "docs.aws.amazon.com", "docs.hetzner.com", "docs.hetzner.cloud", "jitsi.github.io", "nginx.org", "httpd.apache.org", "man7.org", "www.openssh.com", "docs.gitlab.com", "docs.github.com", "owasp.org", "genai.owasp.org", "osv.dev", "deps.dev", "socket.dev", "securityscorecards.dev", "nvd.nist.gov", "www.cve.org", "www.gesetze-im-internet.de", "gesetze-im-internet.de", "eur-lex.europa.eu"]

domains.os_packages.description:
Operating-system package mirrors the sandbox may reach.
Baseline: ["ppa.launchpadcontent.net", "packages.sury.org", "deb.debian.org", "security.debian.org", "archive.ubuntu.com", "security.ubuntu.com", "download.jitsi.org"]

domains.own.description:
Your own domains. network: reachable from the sandbox; webfetch: WebFetch without a question; trusted: named as internal in the auto-mode text. Subdomains adds *.domain.
Baseline: []

domains.package_registries.description:
Package registries the sandbox may reach and WebFetch may read without a question.
Baseline: ["registry.npmjs.org", "registry.yarnpkg.com", "nodejs.org", "api.npmjs.org", "pypi.org", "files.pythonhosted.org", "pypistats.org", "repo.packagist.org", "packagist.org", "getcomposer.org"]

domains.security_sources.description:
Vulnerability and package-health services (OSV, deps.dev); sandbox network and WebFetch.
Baseline: ["api.deps.dev", "api.osv.dev", "api.securityscorecards.dev"]

mcp.allowed_servers.description:
Names of the MCP servers that may start while restrict servers is on.
Baseline: []

patch_scan.projects.description:
Projects /patch-check scans for outdated packages, relative to patch scan root. Read only by the script, not by the hook.
Baseline: []

read_boundary.file_tools_extra.description:
Further paths inside the read boundary that only Read, Grep and Glob may read (Claude's memory, skills, plans); * stands for one folder name.
Baseline: ["~/.claude/CLAUDE.md", "~/.claude/skills", "~/.claude/agents", "~/.claude/commands", "~/.claude/plans", "~/.claude/plugins", "~/.claude/projects/*/memory"]

sandbox.allow_read.description:
Paths inside the read boundary that commands in the sandbox may read (package caches, single config files). A leading ~ is your home folder. Never a folder that can hold tokens.
Baseline: ["~/.nvm", "~/.npm", "~/Library/pnpm", "~/Library/Caches/pnpm", "~/Library/Preferences/pnpm", "~/Library/Caches/pip", "~/Library/Python", "~/.cache/node", "~/.cache/prisma", "~/.ssh/config", "~/.ssh/known_hosts", "~/.gitconfig", "~/.config/git/ignore", "~/.config/git/attributes", "~/.claude/shell-snapshots"]

sandbox.allow_unix_sockets.description:
Unix sockets the sandbox may connect to, e.g. the ssh-agent socket.
Baseline: []

sandbox.allow_write.description:
Extra paths commands in the sandbox may write (e.g. package caches).
Baseline: ["~/.npm", "~/Library/pnpm", "~/Library/Caches/pnpm", "~/Library/Caches/pip", "~/.cache/node", "~/.cache/prisma"]

ssh.hosts.description:
Your servers. The auto-mode text names them as authorized ssh targets: reading is free, every change asks. Add new servers to known_hosts as well.
Baseline: []

webfetch.extra_hosts.description:
Further hosts WebFetch may read without a question, without opening them to the sandbox network.
Baseline: ["github.com", "raw.githubusercontent.com", "gitlab.com"]

working_directories.paths.description:
Folders Claude Code may read and write (additionalDirectories). git network commands run there without a question.
Baseline: []

tighten.description: Stricter only: extra entries, values in their stricter direction.

always_ask.extra_ask.description:
Further permission rules that always ask, e.g. Read(**/.env) or Bash(gh gist *).
Baseline: ["Read(**/.env)", "Read(**/.env.*)", "Bash(gh gist *)"]

always_ask.tools.description:
Command-line tools that always ask and run outside the sandbox, because they need the keychain or a local socket.
Baseline: ["hcloud", "az", "aws", "terraform", "kubectl", "docker", "brew", "composer"]

credentials.env_vars.description:
Environment variables the sandbox removes from every command.
Baseline: ["GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_TOKEN", "GITLAB_TOKEN", "NPM_TOKEN", "HCLOUD_TOKEN", "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "AWS_SESSION_TOKEN", "INFLUX_TOKEN", "INFLUXDB_TOKEN"]

credentials.files.description:
Files and folders the sandbox hides from every command.
Baseline: ["~/.ssh/id_ed25519", "~/.aws", "~/.azure", "~/.config/gh", "~/.config/hcloud", "~/.docker/config.json", "~/.kube", "~/.git-credentials", "~/.netrc", "~/Library/Keychains", "~/.composer/auth.json", "~/.config/git/credentials", "~/.npmrc"]

credentials.read_deny.description:
Paths the Read tool is denied (permission rules Read(...)).
Baseline: ["~/.ssh/id_*", "~/.aws/**", "~/.azure/**", "~/.config/gh/**", "~/.config/hcloud/**", "~/.docker/config.json", "~/.kube/**", "~/.git-credentials", "~/.netrc", "~/Library/Keychains/**", "~/.composer/auth.json", "~/.config/git/credentials", "~/.npmrc"]

data_classes.personal_files.patterns.description:
Regular expressions for files with personal data (access and mail logs); reading one asks first.
Baseline: [{"id": "personal.access-log", "pattern": "access[._-]?log"}, {"id": "personal.mail-log", "pattern": "(^|/)mail\\.(log|info|warn|err)"}, {"id": "personal.auth-log", "pattern": "(^|/)auth\\.log"}, {"id": "personal.secure-log", "pattern": "(^|/)secure(\\.\\d+|\\.gz)?$"}, {"id": "personal.login-records", "pattern": "(^|/)(wtmp|btmp|lastlog)(\\.\\d+)?$"}, {"id": "personal.mailserver-log", "pattern": "(^|/)(exim|dovecot|postfix)[^/]*\\.log"}]

data_classes.secret_files.patterns.description:
Regular expressions for files with credentials; reading a matching file (also on a server) asks first.
Baseline: [{"id": "secret.env", "pattern": "(^|/)\\.env($|[./])"}, {"id": "secret.key-files", "pattern": "\\.(key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore|ppk|asc|gpg)$"}, {"id": "secret.private-pem", "pattern": "(^|/)[^/]*(privkey|private|secret|[-_.]key)[^/]*\\.pem$"}, {"id": "secret.private-dir-pem", "pattern": "/private/[^/]*\\.pem$"}, {"id": "secret.shadow", "pattern": "(^|/)(shadow|gshadow|sudoers)$"}, {"id": "secret.my-cnf", "pattern": "(^|/)\\.?my\\.cnf$"}, {"id": "secret.debian-cnf", "pattern": "(^|/)debian\\.cnf$"}, {"id": "secret.ssh-key", "pattern": "(^|/)id_(rsa|dsa|ecdsa|ed25519)$"}, {"id": "secret.dotfiles", "pattern": "(^|/)\\.(pgpass|htpasswd|netrc|git-credentials)$"}]

logging.log_silent_tools.description:
Calls that are logged even when the hook lets them through silently (ssh, git-network).
Baseline: ["ssh", "git-network"]

read_boundary.linux.description:
Folders (Linux) where reading ends, like read boundary macos. Generated, not yet tested on Linux.
Baseline: ["/home", "/mnt", "/media"]

read_boundary.macos.description:
Folders (macOS) where reading ends: inside them commands in the sandbox and Read, Grep, Glob only reach the working directories and the allow_read paths. @darwin_user_cache_dir is the per-user cache folder of all apps.
Baseline: ["/Users", "/Volumes", "@darwin_user_cache_dir"]

claude_code.lock_lower_scopes.description:
Managed settings become the only source of permission rules and sandbox read paths; rules from ~/.claude and projects stop applying (check with --audit). Stricter only: true.
Baseline: true

claude_code.required_minimum_version.description:
Oldest Claude Code version allowed to start; it must know every setting this product writes. Stricter only: a higher version.
Baseline: "2.1.329"

data_classes.personal_files.ask.description:
Whether reading a file that matches the personal-data patterns asks. Stricter only: true.
Baseline: true

data_classes.secret_files.ask.description:
Whether reading a file that matches the secret patterns asks. Stricter only: true.
Baseline: true

mcp.restrict_servers.description:
Allow only the MCP servers in allowed servers (allowedMcpServers); with an empty list none starts. Stricter only: true.
Baseline: false

package_protection.min_release_age_days.description:
Release-age window for packages in days: npm, pip, uv and Composer install no release younger than this (in Claude Code and, via install.sh, in your terminal). Stricter only: a higher number.
Baseline: 7

package_protection.require_sfw.description:
Package installs only run through Socket Firewall (sfw). Stricter only: true.
Baseline: true

exceptions.description: Each with an id, a reason and an expiry date.

id.description: off: an entry id; set: a tighten value; shadow: a rule id of hooks/guard.py. Locked ids are refused.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD; an expired exception stops the build.

value.description: the new value, only for action set
